FOR DEVELOPERS · REST API + EMBED SDK

Build Verse Engine
into your product.

Upload, publish, embed and track 3D scenes with a REST API — or skip the backend and drop in one script tag.

Get an API key↗API reference ↗
<!-- Embed a scene -->
<script src="https://verse.ctruh.com/embed.js"
        data-scene="your-scene"></script>

Replace your-scene with the published scene ID.

THE ROUND TRIP

  1. 01POST /v1/ingest

    Send a file, a scan or a floor plan.

  2. 02processing

    Verse Engine prepares and signs it once.

  3. 03ready → share link

    Your server hears the moment it’s live.

  4. 04<verse-viewer>

    Drop the ID into any page. Done.
